content.value_statement: Teams often need consistent Anthropic styling across documents and presentations. This skill provides approved colors, typography, and usage guidance for polished brand-aligned artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Provides Anthropic main and accent color values for visual artifacts.
Defines heading and body font choices with fallback fonts.
Guides color use for text, backgrounds, shapes, and accents.
Supports presentation styling through python-pptx color references.
Explains how to preserve readability across common systems.
limitations: It does not include image assets, logos, or downloadable font files.
It does not install Poppins or Lora fonts on the host system.
It does not enforce brand rules automatically in every application.
It focuses on Anthropic styling and is not a general design system.

use_cases.title: Style an Executive Presentation
use_cases.description: Apply Anthropic colors, typography, and accent rules to a leadership deck.

use_cases.title: Format a Customer Report
use_cases.description: Use approved text colors and font fallbacks to make a report feel consistent.

use_cases.title: Review Brand Consistency
use_cases.description: Check whether a document uses the recommended palette, hierarchy, and readable contrast.

prompt_templates.title: Style a Simple Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for basic brand formatting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Anthropic brand guidelines to this document. Use the approved colors, heading fonts, body fonts, and readable contrast.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Slide Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this presentation with Anthropic colors and typography. Use accent colors for shapes and preserve the existing content hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Brand Alignment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for review and recommendations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this artifact against the Anthropic brand guidelines. Identify mismatched colors, weak contrast, and typography issues, then suggest fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Create Implementation Guidance
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for applying rules in a production workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a practical styling plan for applying Anthropic brand guidelines across this recurring report template and future revisions.

output_examples.input: A plain sales presentation needs Anthropic styling.
output_examples.output: The deck uses dark text on light backgrounds, Poppins for headings, Lora for body text, and orange accents for key shapes.

output_examples.input: A report uses mixed fonts and unclear accent colors.
output_examples.output: The report now has consistent heading and body typography, approved accent colors, and a clearer visual hierarchy.

output_examples.input: A brand reviewer needs a concise assessment.
output_examples.output: The review lists color, typography, and contrast issues, with practical corrections for each page or slide.

best_practices: Use the approved palette before adding custom colors.
Pre-install Poppins and Lora when exact typography matters.
Check contrast after applying dark, light, and accent colors.
anti_patterns: Do not mix unrelated palettes with the Anthropic accent colors.
Do not use accent colors for long body text.
Do not assume custom fonts are available on every system.

faq.question: What does this skill help style?
faq.answer: It helps style presentations, documents, and visual artifacts with Anthropic colors and typography.

faq.question: Does it include official logo files?
faq.answer: No. It provides color, typography, and formatting guidance, but it does not include logo assets.

faq.question: Which fonts does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends Poppins for headings and Lora for body text, with Arial and Georgia as fallbacks.

faq.question: Can it work without custom fonts installed?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes fallback fonts so artifacts remain readable when Poppins or Lora are unavailable.

faq.question: Does it run scripts or install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation-only and does not include scripts or dependency installation steps.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
